summary: This annotated messaging screenshot from May 28, 2026, documents the active out-of-pocket diazepam taper timeline for Nicolas Hernandez, followed by an abrupt termination of medical care. The prescriber writes: 'Next rx send, 06/08/2026 - sending month supply - last rx' and 'subscription will be cancelled', proving clinical patient abandonment in the middle of a high-risk benzodiazepine taper. When uploaded to the state's ACMS portal, this proof of care termination forced a panicked, next-day callback from the DHCS Conlan contractor, Gainwell Technologies, asking for March superbills to expedite the claim.
